title: Choking (Adult)
description: Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.

description_translations.en: Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking occurs when a foreign object lodges in the throat or windpipe, blocking the flow of air.

steps.instruction: Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.

instruction_translations.en: Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.

steps.instruction: Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.

instruction_translations.en: Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.

steps.instruction: If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).

instruction_translations.en: If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).

steps.instruction: Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.

instruction_translations.en: Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.

steps.instruction: If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.

instruction_translations.en: If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.

do_not: Do not put your fingers into their mouth unless you can see the object.
Do not give them water to drink.
